author: agent:claude-code
message: parda asks for a forest walked every frame (graft 01a10a4e). Trees are sylva's to own, and the user wants shared structures here, so it's planned as Structures/Forest, beside Tree (which stays the keyed, ordered tree the knowledge model needs). What it asks of the crate as a whole (uuid optional, no_std + alloc, wasm, crates.io) is planned as todos. (proposal 01a10a5f-0061-7377-8b58-0b7a13accb57, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

name: Forest
intent: A forest for trees walked every frame: generational ids, intrusive parent, child and sibling links, and the hot per-node data in columns the caller owns, structure of arrays.

text: Ids are (index, generation): removing a node bumps its slot's generation, so a stale id fails safely and never reaches the slot's next node.

Insert before or after, move and detach are O(1), remove is O(subtree); nothing allocates per node or per child, and traversals (preorder, postorder, children, ancestors, a dirty-subtree walk) allocate nothing once their reusable stack is warm.
Walks follow tree order (the sibling links); only column passes read in slot order, and nothing hashed, serialized or replayed depends on slot order.
No uuid or serde in its dependency path; it builds with no_std + alloc and for wasm32.
At least as fast as a hand-written arena of the same shape (insert, remove a subtree, reorder children, full preorder at 10,000 and 100,000 nodes, a dirty walk with 1% dirty), checked by benchmarks.

title: A second tree, beside Tree, for hot paths
body: Tree<T, K> is keyed through a BTreeMap and keeps a Vec of children per node: right for catalog trees that replay and serialize in key order, too slow for a UI tree walked every frame. Rather than bend Tree, Forest is its own structure with its own trade: generational ids instead of keys, links instead of child lists, columns instead of owned data. Keyed child matching for reconciliation stays with the caller.

title: Benchmarks: Forest against a hand-written arena
body: benches/structures.rs: insert, remove a subtree, reorder children, full preorder at 10,000 and 100,000 nodes, and a dirty walk with 1% dirty; equal or faster.

title: Make uuid optional (a default `uuid` feature)
body: Graph and Tree keep Uuid as their default key behind a `uuid` feature, on by default so Alfred and Tend don't change; the log and knowledge features require it. Forest never uses it.

title: Build the structures with no_std + alloc, and check wasm32
body: A default `std` feature carries what needs std (Error's Io and Db variants, the log's files and SQLite); the structures use alloc's collections. Check `cargo build --no-default-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` in CI.

title: Publish sylva to crates.io under the library license combo
body: Cargo.toml still says license = "UNLICENSED" and the README says "not published"; the library combo is now chosen in .tend/extends.toml. parda needs this to publish itself.
